lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
A single candle flickers in the hall,
Shadows dance against the ancient stone,
The heavy air is thick with quiet prayer,
A silent song for every soul alone.
[Chorus]
Hold the flame against the coming night,
Where the memories breathe and softly bloom,
We walk the path of fading light,
In the hollow of a hallowed room.
[Verse]
The voices rise like smoke in air,
Binding every heart in common grief,
A tapestry of sorrow, woven deep,
Finding solace in a moment brief.
[Chorus]
Hold the flame against the coming night,
Where the memories breathe and softly bloom,
We walk the path of fading light,
In the hollow of a hallowed room.
[Bridge]
The fire wanes, the embers glow,
The steady tides of spirit flow.
[Chorus]
Hold the flame against the coming night,
Where the memories breathe and softly bloom,
We walk the path of fading light,
In the hollow of a hallowed room.
[Outro]
